claim: Upper bounds on ECE estimation bias for uniform-mass and uniform-width binning; optimal bin count B = O(n_te^{1/3}) giving total bias O(1/n_te^{1/3}).
stance_target: L1/F: ECE estimator bias depends on bin count and test size
quoted_support: Our analysis establishes upper bounds on the bias, achieving an improved convergence rate. Moreover, our bounds reveal, for the first time, the optimal number of bins to minimize the estimation bias.

breadth.calibration_metrics: ECE with uniform-mass and uniform-width binning; Eq. 12 bias bound
